evals.prompt: I need to add a discount-code feature to the checkout flow. Let's build it test-first.
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms the seams to test before writing any code, then works in a red-green loop: one failing test, minimal implementation, repeat — not all tests written up front.

evals.prompt: Fix the bug where negative quantities crash the cart total calculation, using TDD.
